gramophone-desc: A modern audio player for wiki pages. The gramophone and playbutton tags play HTML5 audio with playlists and synced lyrics. For compatibility it also renders the flashmp3, sm2 and modernsoundmanager tags of Sm2Shim and FlashMP3, and optionally the ab tag of AudioButton.
gramophone-invalidJson: The playlist is not a valid JSON object.
gramophone-playlistRequired: No playlist was given. Add a "playlist" list with at least one entry that has an "audioFileUrl".
gramophone-too-many-tracks: This page has too many audio tracks. The players on one page can have at most $1 {{PLURAL:$1|track|tracks}} together.
gramophone-tracking-category-desc: The page contains an audio player made with the <gramophone>, <playbutton>, <flashmp3>, <sm2> or <modernsoundmanager> tag, or one of these tags shows an error instead of a player.
gramophone-missing-file-category: Pages with missing audio player files
gramophone-missing-file-category-desc: An audio player on the page refers to a file that does not exist or to an address that cannot be used.
gramophone-lyrics-error: The lyrics could not be loaded.
gramophone-load-error: This audio could not be played.
gramophone-autoplay-blocked: Your browser blocked autoplay. Press play to listen.
